title: Optimal Error Estimates of a Finite Element Method for Semilinear SPDEs with Additive Noise and Nonsmooth Initial Data
summary: This paper presents a strong error analysis of both semidiscrete and fully discrete approximations for semilinear parabolic stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) driven by additive noise and subject to nonsmooth initial data. The spatial discretization is based on a standard finite element method, coupled with the linearly implicit Euler scheme in time.
